SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prescription p INNER JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.id = p.medical_record_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.medical_record_id, mr.appointment_id, pt.id AS patient_id, pt.name AS patient_name, p.status, p.medicine_info, p.usage_info, p.amount, p.create_time FROM prescription p INNER JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.id = p.medical_record_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id INNER JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = mr.patient_id
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.status FROM prescription p INNER JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.id = p.medical_record_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id WHERE p.id = #{prescriptionId} AND d.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET medicine_info = #{request.medicineInfo}, usage_info = #{request.usageInfo}, amount = #{request.amount}, status = #{request.status} WHERE id = #{prescriptionId} AND status = '草稿'
